messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 - inference-eu-1 pool reporting sustained queue starvation and >95% request timeouts. @maya is oncall. Link: https://internal.incidents/1769009999

maya: acked. I’m looking into it — seeing a big spike of queued requests from async batch jobs and a concurrent drop in available workers. Latencies >10s for many requests.

maya: quick findings: autoscaler repeatedly failed to create nodes in eu region. error in kube controller: \"Failed to create instance: image-not-found\" during provisioning.

samir: thanks @maya. I’ve pinged infra-provider support and opened a chase ticket. Meanwhile we can increase per-worker concurrency to temporarily clear backlog. Will coordinate change now.

eli: rough customer impact? any enterprise tenants seeing 5xx or timeouts surfaced?

maya: yes — dedicated tenants with strict routing saw elevated 504s. Example: tenant-acme saw ~30% error rate on tokens-generation endpoints between 11:02–11:28 UTC. We’re currently routing some traffic to fallback pools.

maya: logs snippet: ```
E0309 11:01:43.123 kube-controller.go:210] create instance failed: cannot find image \"redwood-runtime:2026-03-09\"
E0309 11:01:44.456 autoscaler.go:89] provision attempt 3 failed: image-not-found
```

ops-bot: Auto-fallback executed: 12% of traffic rerouted to inference-us-west-2 to maintain SLOs. Route change id: rc-7743. :information_source:

nina: picking this up from @maya for the handoff. @maya can you summarize current mitigations and state?

maya: handoff summary: 1) pinned runtime image to previous stable tag to allow provisioning; 2) increased worker concurrency from 8 -> 12; 3) routing policy currently keeps 12% fallback to us-west-2; 4) backlog processed ~70% now. Autoscaler retry still flaky until infra publishes image.

samir: infra confirmed publishing pipeline had a bad manifest push; provider accepted a retry and image is now available but old nodes need rolling. I’ll run a controlled drain/roll to bring capacity back. ETA for full capacity ~2h.

eli: agree we should treat this as an incident with customer impact. Propose postmortem + communication plan. Who will own outreach to affected tenants?

maya: I can draft notifications and coordinate credits if legal/product confirm. Will add affected tenant list and error windows.

samir: remediation action items (initial):
- [ ] Fix publishing pipeline: ensure manifest validation and retry (owner: samir, ETA: 3d)
- [ ] Add autoscaler backoff & retry logic to handle transient image errors (owner: nina, ETA: 5d)
- [ ] Add synthetic image-availability probe before autoscaler launches instances (owner: eli, ETA: 4d)
- [ ] Lower fallback activation threshold for routing to avoid larger cross-region shifts (owner: maya, ETA: 2d)
- [ ] Postmortem doc & runbook update (owner: maya, ETA: 1d)

nina: I’ll take autoscaler retry item. Also will add a dashboard tile showing instance provision fail rate and image pull errors so we alert earlier.

maya: scheduling: propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I’ll create calendar invite and start a doc in #postmortems.

incident-bot: Incident status update: RESOLVED (partial) at 1769011000. Backlog processing ongoing; capacity returning to normal.

eli: please make sure the postmortem includes: timeline of events, why the image manifest pushed without validation, why autoscaler didn't fail more gracefully, and what tests/monitors we add. Also include customer impact table with tenants, windows, and error counts.

maya: will draft the report. Quick runbook updates needed: add preflight check `curl <image-registry>/manifests/<tag>` and fail early before autoscaler executes. I’ll open a PR after postmortem.

samir: created internal ticket TICKET-4822 for publishing pipeline fixes (https://issues.internal/TICKET-4822). I’ll link PRs there.

nina: note: I changed alert thresholds to fire earlier for image pull >5 failures / 5m. Will monitor for noisy alerts and iterate.

maya: final notes for handoff: Nina owns follow-ups for infra code, Samir owns publishing pipeline, Eli owns probes and postmortem verification, I’ll own postmortem writeup and customer comms. We’ll reconvene after doc draft. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

maya: pinging #postmortems when draft ready and will tag everyone for the review.
